what: In the center window of the hero panel (40% wide, 100px margin top and bottom), seven photos switch on one by one over .3s each at 0, .78, 1.22, 1.58, 1.86, 2.11 and 2.34s and stack up, a flicker that speeds up as the gaps narrow. At 2.6s the cover panel (video) turns on at the window size over .3s, and 1s later it expands from the window to the full panel over 1.2s, after which the corners round to 20px. .8s after the expansion starts, fx:done fires (the original brings in the headline and copy at this point).

options.times: Seconds at which images turn on, comma-separated, default ”0, .78, 1.22, 1.58, 1.86, 2.11, 2.34”
options.flash: Duration for one photo to turn on (sec), default .3
options.hold: Time until the cover panel turns on (s), default 2.6
options.fade: Duration of the cover panel turning on (s), default .3
options.expand: Duration (sec) of the spread from window to full board, default 1.2
options.w: Window width (for clip calculation, css value), default 40% — give the same value as css-side --fx-w
options.h: Window height (css value), default calc(100% - 200px) — set together with --fx-h
options.on: If play, starts when fx:play is sent to the panel (e.g. after the loading curtain lifts), default right on attach
options.[data-fx-part=reveal]: Cover panel to unfold — if it contains a video, it plays when opened

use: …

from.where: index.html .ix-hero__image (original hero__opening_image__item, seven images, animation .3s ease · delay .78~2.34s, after 2600ms hero__image__item _step01 .3s → after 1000ms _step02 clip-path 1.2s ease → after 1200ms _radius 20px .3s). The site applies the same values as class steps.

note: The original sets the window (580×(100%−200) units) with clip-path polygon — the part sets the same window with inset() and unfolds it
